esp32_note: The ESP32/CAM typically has ~320 KB SRAM usable by TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers. A multi-crop foliar MobileNetV2-derived model (tens of MB) cannot fit on-device. Recommended architecture: ESP32-CAM captures and streams JPEG over Wi-Fi to the Flask server, which runs the REAL inference and returns the result. On-device inference is not claimed.
